item.title: Create polls with Murph
item.summary: Ask Murph to create a native poll in your current iMessage or Telegram conversation, then ask it for the results.
item.details: Murph can find polls it created in that conversation. iMessage votes are public and allow multiple choices. Telegram polls are anonymous, use one choice, and can be closed on request; results reflect the latest update Murph has received.

tryIt.label: Create a poll
tryIt.prompt: Create a poll here: Which day for our walk? Options: Saturday and Sunday.
